newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Incentive may sell Hagglunds - paper.
newsitem.headline: Incentive may sell Hagglunds - paper.

text.p: Swedish investment group Incentive has put Hagglunds Vehicle on its unofficial sell list and defence/technology company Celsius may be interested in buying it, a Swedish paper said on Friday.
Hagglunds Vehicle, which produces tracked vehicles primarily for military use, has an annual turnover of over one billion crowns and 950 staff.
Daily business newspaper Dagens Industri said this no longer fitted into Incentive's new stratgey which focuses on medical technology.
Celsius managing director Olof Lund said a Swedish owner or alliance would be best for Hagglunds.
He told Dagens Industri that the company was looking at the possibilities of making a deal.
"The company has many similarities with (arms manufacturer) Bofors," Lundtold said. "We know each other well. We are looking at this."
